title: Document
description: Canonical document model of the document seam, version 0.1.0. Aligned to TM Forum TMF667 v5 (Document, Attachment); extensions are named in x-extension and in docs/tmf667-mapping.md. A Document is metadata plus links; the binary lives in a content store and is reached only through a short-lived URL (rule 1). Status and pipelineState are two different axes (rule 5).

documentType.description: Code from DocumentSpecification.documentType (configured per tenant). Examples: contract, quote, orderAttachment, kycOutcome, bill, technicalDoc.

version.description: Label of the current effective version (for example 3 or 3.1-signed).

status.description: Lifecycle. TMF667 gives status as a free string; this is our vocabulary. Terminal for edits: superseded, expired, archived.

pipelineState.description: Processing of the current version. The UI shows this on every row. quarantined = malware scan flagged the file; content is never served.

reasonKey.description: i18n key; never a backend message.

signatureLevel.description: eIDAS level of the signature carried by the current version, when any. Evidence package is held by the signature provider.

origin.description: generated = produced from a DocumentSpecification template (for example a quote PDF built from the quote). SID: GeneratedDocument vs SimpleDocument. The generate operation is not in seam 0.1.0.

bundle.description: Membership of a document set, such as a contract (core) with its annexes. SID: DocumentSet. TMF667 has no set; only documentRelationship.

validFor.description: Legal or commercial effectiveness (a contract's term). Different from expiryDate. TMF667 v5 states the distinction explicitly.

expiryDate.description: Administrative expiry of the document (for example an insurance certificate). Reaching it moves status to expired. TMF667 uses date-time; the prototype stores a date.

relatedEntity.description: The business entities this document belongs to. Access is inherited from these (rule 4). A document with no entity is not allowed.

role.description: contract, orderAttachment, quoteDocument, kycOutcome, billCopy, supportingEvidence

attachedOnDateTime.description: When the document was attached to this entity. SID Attachment.attachedOnDateTime; may differ from the start of validity.

relatedEntity.x-tmf667: Document.relatedEntity is a SINGLE RelatedEntity (role + entity) in v5; ours is an array. The adapter sends the first as relatedEntity and the others as characteristic relatedEntity.N (see docs/tmf667-mapping.md).

relatedParty.x-tmf667: Document.relatedParty items are RelatedPartyRefOrPartyRoleRef {role, partyOrPartyRole{id, href, name, @referredType}}; ours flattens to {role, partyId, displayName}.

documentRelationship.x-tmf667: Document.documentRelationship items are DocumentRef (id, href, name, version) with NO relationship type in v5; the adapter carries relationshipType in the ref's name or as a characteristic.

externalIdentifier.description: Ids in other systems (content store item id, signature envelope id). Never the content URL.

characteristic.description: Type-specific metadata governed by DocumentSpecification.specCharacteristic (for example contractNumber, counterparty, renewalDate). Fields that tmf667 lacks and that every type needs are promoted to typed properties above, not hidden here.

retention.x-extension: retention is a policy over versions, not over the file (rule 3 and SharePoint evidence)

DocumentVersion.description: One immutable version. Maps to a TMF667 Attachment. Never overwritten; a new file is a new version.

label.description: Human label: 1, 2, 3 or a given name.

isNamed.description: false = automatic checkpoint; true = named by a person, with note.
